d:
Good morning, friends! Welcome back to another video on the Raipur-Visakhapatnam Expressway. In this video, we'll take you on a detailed tour of Package 1, a 42.852 km stretch being constructed by Shalimar Corporation.
We'll start from Abhanpur & go all the way to the Mahanadi River, covering:
The progress of interchanges being built at Abhanpur
The construction status of elevated sections connecting NH30 & NH130C
Updates on the construction of bridges and ROBs (Road Over Bridges)
Areas where work is complete & areas where it's still pending
